title: Crazy Diamond (JCraft Addon)
description: Adds Crazy Diamond as a new stand to JCraft 0.18.0+ (JOJO, JJBA)
body:
Adds Crazy Diamond as a new stand to JCraft 0.18.0+

**This adds an entire new stand to JCraft with custom abilities! He doesn't replace ANY stands and he is an addition to your JCraft!**

Download this if you want to play with Crazy Diamond in JCraft


A user would download this to add a new stand to JCraft


Crazy Diamond's abilities are exactly like how they are in the anime of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure


This REQUIRES JCraft Additions 1.0.0 or above!



Crazy Diamond is the main JoJo's stand of Diamond is Unbreakable. Crazy Diamond possesses the ability to heal or repair anything with just a touch.



THIS MOD USES THE UNUSED MODEL STRAIGHT FROM THE FILES OF THE GAME. I AM NOT REDISTRIBUTING THE MODEL, JUST DIRECTING MY MOD TO USE THE ONE ALREADY IN JCRAFT. IF THE JCRAFT DEVS ASK ME TO CHANGE THIS, I WILL HAVE TO.



Crazy Diamond is obtained by using a stand arrow.



_"Ironic. He could save others from death, but not himself."_



**Use "/stand about" to view all of Crazy Diamond's abilities.**



If you have questions about this mod, MESSAGE ME! The JCraft Devs did not make this mod so they will not be able to help you.
